Then too, there are many so-called "bugs" which are not insects at all. Spiders, thousand-legs, crawfishes and even earth-worms are often spoken of as bugs.

arxiv-2006-11058.title: Empirical Relations for the Sensitivities of Solar-like Oscillations to Magnetic Perturbations 2020 Empirical Relations for the Sensitivities of Solar-like Oscillations to Magnetic Perturbations – A.2
arxiv-2006-11058.creator: René Kiefer, Anne-Marie Broomhall
arxiv-2006-11058.description: Abstract Oscillation mode frequencies of stars are typically treated as static for a given stellar model. However, in reality they can be perturbed by time varying sources such as magnetic fields and flows. We calculate the sensitivities of radial p-mode oscillations of a set of models for masses between 0.7–3.

arxiv-2101-00098.title: OralViewer: 3D Demonstration of Dental Surgeries for Patient Education with Oral Cavity Reconstruction from a 2D Panoramic X-ray CCS: Human-centered computing Human computer interaction (HCI)
arxiv-2101-00098.creator: Yuan Liang, Liang Qiu, Tiancheng Lu, Zhujun Fang, Dezhan Tu, Jiawei Yang, Tiandong Zhao, Yiting Shao, Kun Wang, Xiang ‘Anthony’ Chen, Lei He
arxiv-2101-00098.description: Abstract . Patient’s understanding on forthcoming dental surgeries is required by patient-centered care and helps reduce fear and anxiety. Due to the gap of expertise between patients and dentists, conventional techniques of patient education are usually not effective for explaining surgical steps.

arxiv-2108-10032.title: On generalized Berwald manifolds of dimension three
arxiv-2108-10032.creator: Csaba Vincze, Márk Oláh
arxiv-2108-10032.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Csaba Vincze, Márk Oláh. A linear connection on a Finsler manifold is called compatible to the Finsler function if its parallel transports preserve the Finslerian length of tangent vectors. Generalized Berwald manifolds are Finsler manifolds equipped with a compatible linear connection. In the paper we present a general and intrinsic method to characterize the compatible linear connections on a Finsler manifold of dimension three. We prove that if a compatible linear connection is not unique then the indicatrices must be Euclidean surfaces of revolution.

arxiv-2209-00721.title: Generalizing intrusion detection for heterogeneous networks: A stacked-unsupervised federated learning approach Journal: Computers & Security
arxiv-2209-00721.creator: Gustavo de Carvalho Bertoli, Lourenço Alves Pereira Junior, Osamu Saotome, Aldri Luiz dos Santos
arxiv-2209-00721.description: Abstract The constantly evolving digital transformation imposes new requirements on our society. Aspects relating to reliance on the networking domain and the difficulty of achieving security by design pose a challenge today. As a result, data-centric and machine-learning approaches arose as feasible solutions for securing large networks.

arxiv-2212-00691.title: Reducing Rouquier complexes
arxiv-2212-00691.creator: Leonardo Maltoni
arxiv-2212-00691.description: Abstract We describe reduced representatives for positive Rouquier complexes. These are obtained via Morse theoretical Gaussian elimination from the corresponding standard representatives. The underlying graded object is still a direct sum of Bott-Samelson objects, but over subwords rather than subexpressions. Introduction Rouquier complexes were introduced in [ 25 ] to study actions of the (generalized) braid group on categories.

arxiv-2312-14123.title: The interacting vacuum and tensions: a comparison of theoretical models Journal: Physics of the Dark Universe
arxiv-2312-14123.creator: Marco Sebastianutti, Natalie B. Hogg, Marco Bruni
arxiv-2312-14123.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Marco Sebastianutti, Natalie B. Hogg, Marco Bruni. We analyse three interacting vacuum dark energy models with the aim of exploring whether the H 0 H_{0} and σ 8 \sigma_{8} tensions can be simultaneously resolved in such models. We present the first ever derivation of the covariant gauge-invariant perturbation formalism for the interacting vacuum scenario, and, for the sub-class of geodesic cold dark matter models, connect the evolution of perturbation variables in this approach to the familiar cosmological observables.

arxiv-2404-05479.title: Behavioural Types for Heterogeneous Systems (Position Paper)
arxiv-2404-05479.creator: Simon Fowler, Philipp Haller, Roland Kuhn, Sam Lindley, Alceste Scalas, Vasco T. Vasconcelos
arxiv-2404-05479.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Simon Fowler, Philipp Haller, Roland Kuhn, Sam Lindley, Alceste Scalas, Vasco T. Vasconcelos. Behavioural types provide a promising way to achieve lightweight, language-integrated verification for communication-centric software. However, a large barrier to the adoption of behavioural types is that the current state of the art expects software to be written using the same tools and typing discipline throughout a system, and has little support for components over which a developer has no control.

arxiv-2408-10824.title: Emerging clean technologies: policy-driven cost reductions, implications and perspectives
arxiv-2408-10824.creator: Mohamed Atouife, Jesse Jenkins
arxiv-2408-10824.description: Abstract keywords Emerging technologies, technology policy, electrolysis, direct air capture, e-kerosene, experience curves, climate mitigation. Context & Scale Early stage policy support is critical for the demonstration, commercialization and diffusion of nascent technologies. Policy-induced deployment unlocks cost reductions through learning-by-doing, driving further deployment and greater cost reductions, thus enabling a positive feedback loop.

arxiv-2503-05947.title: Illuminating the Physics of Dark Energy with the Discovery Simulations
arxiv-2503-05947.creator: Gillian D. Beltz-Mohrmann 1,⋆, Adrian Pope 2, Alex Alarcon 1,4, Michael Buehlmann 2, Nicholas Frontiere 2, Andrew P. Hearin 1, Katrin Heitmann 1, Sara Ortega-Martinez 1,5, Alan Pearl 1, Esteban Rangel 2, Silvio Rizzi 3, Thomas Uram 3, Enia Xhakaj 1
arxiv-2503-05947.description: Abstract In this paper, we present the Discovery simulations: a new pair of high-resolution N-body simulations motivated by the DESI Y1 BAO cosmological constraints on dark energy. The Discovery simulations were run with identical initial conditions, and differ only in their cosmological parameters.

arxiv-2511-16054.title: Learning Tractable Distributions of Language Model Continuations
arxiv-2511-16054.creator: Gwen Yidou-Weng, Ian Li, Anji Liu, Oliver Broadrick, Guy Van den Broeck, Benjie Wang
arxiv-2511-16054.description: Abstract Controlled language generation conditions text on sequence-level constraints (for example, syntax, style, or safety). These constraints may depend on future tokens, which makes directly conditioning an autoregressive language model (LM) generally intractable. Prior work uses tractable surrogates such as hidden Markov models (HMMs) to approximate the distribution over continuations and adjust the model’s next-token logits at decoding time.

pmc-11387503.creator: Lijun Yang, Xiang Zhang, Zhou Zhong, Jiping Li, Zhongwei Xiong
pmc-11387503.description: Plate fixation is a common treatment option for radial head fractures (RHFs). Due to the benefits of less invasiveness and fewer complications of internal fixation, the application of small-diameter headless compression screws (HCSs) to treat RHFs has become a new trend.

pmc-11504988.creator: Courtney Takats, Gregory Putzel, Drew Siskin, Alejandro Pironti, Bo Shopsin, Sarah Hochman
pmc-11504988.description: Background: The frequency of Staphylococcus aureus transmission in hospitals is unknown: symptomatic infection may occur months after transmission and colonization, and infection prevention efforts rely on indirect measurements, rather than direct detection of transmission events. We implemented a hospital-based S. aureus screening program, combined with whole genome sequencing of S.

pmc-12374986.title: AI-enhanced rapid diagnostic testing platform for mass opisthorchiasis screening
pmc-12374986.creator: Prem Junsawang, Anchalee Techasen, Kannika Wiratchawa, Yupaporn Wanna, Phattharaphon Wongphutorn, Chanika Worasith, Paiboon Sithithaworn, Sahan Bulathwela, Thanapong Intharah
pmc-12374986.description: Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is a prevalent malignancy in countries along Mekong basin, closely linked to chronic infections caused by Opisthorchis viverrini (OV). Early detection of OV-infected individuals holds significant promise for screening at-risk populations in endemic regions. Recent advancements in immunochromatographic methods have led to the development of a rapid diagnostic test (RDT) based on urinary antigens.

pmc-12395631.title: Use of MRI-double inversion recovery sequence for early diagnosis of multiple sclerosis: case series
pmc-12395631.creator: Dan Zhu, Yongjia Shao, Nana Zhang, Zhourui Wu, Liming Cheng, Hongyu Zhou, ShuGuang Chu
pmc-12395631.description: The choice of additional Double Inversion Recovery (DIR) Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) sequences may affect the judgment of the presence and nature of lesions. Herein, we reported three cases initially presenting with non-typical multiple sclerosis (MS) symptoms, in which the final diagnosis of MS was confirmed after incorporating spinal cord and brain DIR MRI sequence.

pmc-12471566.title: Possibilities and Principles of Formation of Functionally Graded Ceramic Armor by Additive Manufacturing
pmc-12471566.creator: Eugene Medvedovski, Nahum Travitzky, Alexander Yu Churyumov, David Marrero Lopez
pmc-12471566.description: Ceramic armor with improved ballistic performance, lower weight, and, in specific cases, complex geometry is of high importance for the armor integrators and users. The combination of a high level of consolidation and the tailored heterogeneous structures of these ceramics may be important for reducing fracturing and delaying crack propagation under high-velocity ballistic impacts, therefore improving their ballistic performance.

pmc-12547159.title: Development and validation of an artificial intelligence system for triple-negative breast cancer identification and prognosis prediction: a multicentre retrospective study
pmc-12547159.creator: Xiu-Ming Zhang, Hua-Jun Zhou, Qing Chen, Xi Wang, Yu-Juan Fu, Cheng Jin, Feng-Tao Zhou, Jing-Ping Wang, Qiu-Yu Cai, Ji-Li Wang, Bo Luo, Mao-Tong Hu, Cai-Yun Yao, Xia Yang, Ya-Li Xu, Jing Zhang, Hao Chen
pmc-12547159.description: SummaryBackgroundTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), recognised as the most aggressive subtype of breast cancer, has a high recurrence rate and poor treatment outcomes. Current diagnosis relies heavily on immunohistochemistry, which can be time-consuming and costly, while prognostic stratification remains limited by traditional clinicopathological features.

pmc-12594076.title: Decentralized and Dynamic: The Sociomaterial Flow of Peer-Led Learning in Digital Spaces
pmc-12594076.creator: Siew Ping Han, Nevin Chua Yi Meng, Emmanuel Tan Chee Peng, Jennifer Cleland
pmc-12594076.description: Introduction:Social media has transformed medical education by facilitating learner-led digital communities that co-construct knowledge. Previous studies position it as a passive information delivery tool. This fails to capture complex relationships between learners and technologies that may create new potentials for learning, teaching, and participation in the educational process.

pmc-12679429.title: Application of radiotherapy-preexcited gambogic acid dual targeting nanoparticles in colorectal cancer
pmc-12679429.creator: Liuqi Sang, Qun Zhang, Zixin Liang, Xinyi Xu, Xueying Bai, Ning Wang, Xingzhi Han, Li Li, Jing Hu, Xiaoping Qian
pmc-12679429.description: Delivering anti-tumor drugs to the correct location is an important strategy for improving tumor treatment efficacy and reducing side effects. To this end, this study developed a P-selectin-targeted drug delivery platform, where fucoidan-modified PLGA nanoparticles were loaded with the anti-tumor drug gambogic acid (GA) to form a novel nanoparticle, Fucoidan-PLGA/GA NPs (FPG).

pmc-13267171.title: Inhaled Virus-Mimicking Particles Elicit Dose-Dependent Immune Response against SARS-CoV‑2 with Sex-Bias ACE2 Activity in Mice
pmc-13267171.creator: Pei Zhang, Erik Niemelä, Panagiotis Filis, Pasi Sorvisto, Jani Virtanen, Hélder A. Santos
pmc-13267171.description: There is an urgent need to develop antigen presentation platforms that can induce broadly systemic immunity against multiple severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) subvariants. Here, virus-mimicking particles (VMP) are functionalized with substantial receptor binding domain protrusions from Delta variant SARS-CoV-2 on particle surface, programmed by biotin–streptavidin interaction.

pmc-13460147.title: Draft genome sequencing of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli strain AHSTU04 isolated from bovine milk in China
pmc-13460147.creator: Muhammad Haris, Wang Zekai, Hasnain Ali Khan, He Shaojun
pmc-13460147.description: We report the draft genome sequence of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli strain AHSTU04, isolated from bovine raw milk in Anhui, China. The 4.96-Mbp genome shows phenotypic resistance to oxacillin and other antibiotics via disk diffusion, harbors 189 virulence factors, lacks plasmids, and acquired antimicrobial resistance genes, suggesting that resistance is intrinsic.

pmc-13516574.title: Triazine-Mediated Zero-Length Crosslinking for Sustainable Leather Tanning
pmc-13516574.creator: Valentina Beghetto, Eleonora Fabris, Francesco de Laurentiis, Marco Nogarole, Domenico Santandrea, Dior Tall
pmc-13516574.description: The study presents a sustainable, metal-free tanning system based on 2-chloro-4,6-dimethoxy-1,3,5-triazine (CDMT) and N-methylmorpholine (NMM), which stabilizes collagen through a zero-length crosslinking mechanism. Reactive triazine intermediates, generated in situ, selectively activate collagen carboxyl groups, forming active esters that subsequently react with amine functionalities to form amide bonds.

pmc-13530880.title: Advanced three-dimensional culture technologies in reproductive medicine: A narrative review
pmc-13530880.creator: Annahita Ghaedrahmati, Mohammad Zandi
pmc-13530880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent advancements in 3-dimensional (3D) in vitro culture systems for follicles, oocytes, and embryos represent a paradigm shift in assisted reproductive technologies and reproductive biology. By mimicking the native physiological microenvironment more faithfully than conventional 2-dimensional systems, these innovative platforms directly address critical limitations of current in vitro embryo production protocols, including low blastocyst development rates, compromised embryo quality, and concerning epigenetic aberrations.

pmc-13686178.title: Multi-label Contextual Operator Inference in Knowledge Acquisition for Building Generalization: A Multi-modal Learning Approach
pmc-13686178.creator: Joris Senn, Zhiyong Zhou, Cheng Fu, Robert Weibel
pmc-13686178.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In traditional map generalization, knowledge acquisition refers to formalizing individual generalization operators and chaining multiple operators into an overall process. It is an essential step towards automating map generalization. To date, machine learning, including advanced deep learning (DL), has been frequently applied to implement individual operators or end-to-end solutions, reducing or even bypassing the intensive effort required to elicit generalization knowledge from expert cartographers.
